rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Is everyone here? I will explain the current situation.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The trouble is, we have no idea at all where we are<thumbnail(168)>. We cannot reach HQ either.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>For now, I will tell you what can be inferred about the current situation.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Back then, the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> was giving off a specific energy<thumbnail(166)> that was detected.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>I believe it is what is called <color(6)>Baldora particles<ce()>.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>And right before we came here, energy of excessive mass was also observed.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>A phenomenon that occurred because they set the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> in motion... That much can be inferred.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>What all this suggests is... that we may have been sent to some far-off planet.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>But this is no more than a possibility. I ask everyone to respond calmly.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>One more thing. An emergency seems to have come up during the survey of the area. Capt. <color(4)>Amuro<ce()>, the details, please.
rows.notes: Taii rendered Capt. (army-style, as corpus did for Burning).

rows.en: <thumbdown()><topic()><operator(30010,1)><speed(2)>Fighting between units of unknown affiliation has been confirmed up ahead.
<operator(30010,1)><speed(2)>None of the machines are in the database; they seem to be unidentified types<thumbnail(170)>. And they seem to have noticed us.
<operator(30010,1)><speed(2)>The larger unit<thumbnail(171)> is spreading out to encircle us and attack. The enemy numbers are considerable.
<operator(30010,1)><speed(2)>If Lt. Cmdr. <color(4)>Hoshino<ce()> has it right, this is an unknown planet and the enemy is an unknown force, but...
<operator(30010,1)><speed(2)>In any case, the ship's safety comes first. We go out to intercept.
<operator(30010,1)><speed(2)>The other, smaller force is sending out a <color(6)>distress signal<ce()>. They seem to have no intent to fight, but...
<thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>We cannot deem them allies either. Contact will be tried for now, but if they turn hostile to us, we fight back.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>This may develop into combat with both sides, so let us respond carefully.

uncertainties.issue: Amuro taii rendered "Capt." (army-style, consistent with corpus "Captain Burning"); official CCA English dub uses "Lieutenant". Could not open Gundam wiki (HTTP 402) to verify. Risk of confusion with ship captains.
"energy of excessive mass" is literal (kajou na shitsuryou no enerugii); the source itself is technobabble.
"they" = the unknown mobile-weapon force from mission 03 (karera no te ni yotte); inferred from previous meeting.
Source omits subject for contact/return fire; mixed passive + "we" (wareware is explicit only for "hostile to us").

glossary_proposals.why: Rank abbreviation for Amuro in CCA era; corpus already uses Captain for Burning (same rank). Official dub says Lieutenant; orchestrator to decide.
Already used in Encyclopedia but not in any glossary file.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title equals missions_019 "04  Sweep Unknown Forces".
Slot 28 ruling: "Capt." for Amuro's rank kept per orchestrator decision.
Slot 24 ruling: "energy of excessive mass" is a faithful literal of source technobabble; kept.
Slot 25 ruling: "they" is explicit in the source ("karera no te ni yotte"), not invented; kept.
Slot 35 ruling: passive "Contact will be tried" plus "we fight back" is acceptable; "wareware ni" is explicit in the source.
Slot 32: "Lt. Cmdr. Hoshino" matches released 4003020 and meeting_terms_015.
Thumbnail positions in slots 20, 22, 30, 31 correspond to the source.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 22: "Back then" for "ano toki" refers to the mission 03 battle; referent inferred from the previous meeting.
Slot 28: rank "Capt." could be misread as a ship captain; orchestrator decision applied.
